image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a voluminous, curly black wig. The subject's face is heavily made up with prosthetic-style applications on the forehead and nose bridge, featuring orange/brown textured patches that resemble reptile skin or decay. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the texture of the wig and the facial prosthetics against a dark background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The orange/brown patches on the face have a slightly 'painted-on' or smudged texture that lacks fine pore detail compared to the rest of the skin. This may be intentional makeup/prosthetic style, but it borders on AI texturing inconsistency.
Slight softness/bleeding at the very outer edges of the hair against the pure black background, typical of generation or heavy compression, but not structurally damaging.
